```{r}
library(lubridate)

bool_cols <- c("amenity", "bump", "crossing", "give_way", "junction",
               "no_exit", "railway", "roundabout", "station", "stop",
               "traffic_calming", "traffic_signal", "turning_loop")

accidents <- accidents %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(bool_cols), ~ as.logical(.)))
```

```{r}
accidents <- accidents %>% mutate(accident_duration_min = as.numeric(difftime(end_time, start_time, units = "mins")))
```

```{r}
essential <- c("severity", "start_lat", "start_lng")

accidents_clean <- accidents %>%
  filter(if_all(all_of(essential), ~ !is.na(.)))

accidents_clean <- accidents_clean %>% distinct(id, .keep_all = TRUE)
```

```{r}
accidents <- accidents_clean
```

# Analysis 1: PCA on Weather + Road Features

# Goal: Reduce dimensionality and understand variance structure.
```{r}
#  1. Select Weather + Road Features
weather_road_vars <- accidents %>%
  dplyr::select(temperature_f, wind_chill_f, humidity_percent, pressure_in,
         visibility_mi, wind_speed_mph, precipitation_in,
         amenity, bump, crossing, give_way, junction,
         no_exit, railway, roundabout, station, stop,
         traffic_calming, traffic_signal)
```

```{r}
# 2. Remove Rows with Missing Values
pca_data <- weather_road_vars %>% drop_na()
```

```{r}
# 3. Standardize the Data
pca_data_scaled <- scale(pca_data)
```

```{r}
# 4. Run PCA
pca_result <- prcomp(pca_data_scaled, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
summary(pca_result)
```

```{r}
library(factoextra)
library(ggforce)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

# Compute % variance
eig_vals <- pca_result$sdev^2
eig_df   <- data.frame(
  PC       = seq_along(eig_vals),
  Variance = eig_vals / sum(eig_vals) * 100
)

# Plot
fig1_clean <- ggplot(eig_df, aes(PC, Variance)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#4C72B0", width = 0.7) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Variance), size = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2, color = "#DD8452") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", Variance)),
            vjust = -0.5, size = 3) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = eig_df$PC) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(scale = 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Scree Plot: Variance Explained by Principal Components",
    x     = "Principal Component",
    y     = "Percent of Variance"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  )

fig1_clean

library(factoextra)
library(ggplot2)

# Top 10 contributors to PC1
fig_c1 <- fviz_contrib(
  pca_result,
  choice = "var",
  axes   = 1,
  top    = 10
) +
  labs(
    title = "Top 10 Variable Contributions to PC1",
    x     = "Variable",
    y     = "Contribution (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

fig_c1

library(pheatmap)

# Extract loadings for PCs 1–5
load_mat <- pca_result$rotation[, 1:5]

# Draw heatmap
pheatmap(
  load_mat,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  display_numbers = TRUE,
  number_format   = "%.2f",
  main = "Heatmap of Variable Loadings (PC1–PC5)"
)
```
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(hexbin) 

# 1) Rebuild PCA input with severity, drop NAs
pca_df <- accidents %>%
  dplyr::select(
    severity,
    temperature_f, wind_chill_f, humidity_percent, pressure_in,
    visibility_mi, wind_speed_mph, precipitation_in,
    amenity, bump, crossing, give_way, junction,
    no_exit, railway, roundabout, station, stop,
    traffic_calming, traffic_signal
  ) %>%
  tidyr::drop_na()

# 2) Ensure pca_result exists (you may skip if already computed)
features_scaled <- scale(dplyr::select(pca_df, -severity))
pca_result <- prcomp(features_scaled, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

# 3) Build a scores data.frame with severity
scores_df <- as.data.frame(pca_result$x) %>%
  mutate(severity = factor(pca_df$severity))

# 4) Balanced subsample: 2k points per severity class
set.seed(2025)
scores_balanced <- scores_df %>%
  group_by(severity) %>%
  slice_sample(n = 2000) %>%
  ungroup()

# 5) Extract % variance for PC1–PC3
imp    <- summary(pca_result)$importance
pc1var <- imp[2,1] * 100
pc2var <- imp[2,2] * 100
pc3var <- imp[2,3] * 100

# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Plot A: Balanced scatter PC1 vs PC2
ggplot(scores_balanced, aes(PC1, PC2, color = severity)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1) +
  coord_equal() +
  scale_color_brewer("Severity", palette = "Set1") +
  labs(
    title = "Balanced Subsample: PC1 vs PC2 by Severity",
    x = sprintf("PC1 (%.1f%%)", pc1var),
    y = sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", pc2var)
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Plot B: Hexbin density of ALL scores
ggplot(scores_df, aes(PC1, PC2)) +
  geom_hex(bins = 50) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "C", trans = "log10", name = "Count") +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    title = "Hexbin Density: PC1 vs PC2",
    x = sprintf("PC1 (%.1f%%)", pc1var),
    y = sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", pc2var)
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Plot C: Hexbin faceted by severity (balanced)
ggplot(scores_balanced, aes(PC1, PC2)) +
  geom_hex(bins = 40) +
  facet_wrap(~ severity) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    title = "Hexbin: PC1 vs PC2 by Severity",
    x = sprintf("PC1 (%.1f%%)", pc1var),
    y = sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", pc2var)
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Plot D: 2D density contours by severity (balanced)
ggplot(scores_balanced, aes(PC1, PC2, color = severity)) +
  geom_density_2d(size = 1) +
  coord_equal() +
  scale_color_brewer("Severity", palette = "Set1") +
  labs(
    title = "2D Density Contours: PC1 vs PC2 by Severity",
    x = sprintf("PC1 (%.1f%%)", pc1var),
    y = sprintf("PC2 (%.1f%%)", pc2var)
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Plot E: PC1 vs PC3 scatter (balanced)
ggplot(scores_balanced, aes(PC1, PC3, color = severity)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1) +
  coord_equal() +
  scale_color_brewer("Severity", palette = "Set1") +
  labs(
    title = "PC1 vs PC3 by Severity",
    x = sprintf("PC1 (%.1f%%)", pc1var),
    y = sprintf("PC3 (%.1f%%)", pc3var)
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
```
